text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
together with Eishin Flash—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —A hot springs trip?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ticket I had been holding onto since 
the raffle. Now that racing season has 
calmed down, I told her it was a good time 
to use it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I suppose we can go ahead 
and add it to the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll adjust our schedule now, so please 
think about when would be best—
choice_data_list:
How about we schedule it for next week's 
day off?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However... I already have race film study 
scheduled for that day."
choice_data_list: It doesn't say where it is, does it?
It doesn't say where it is, does it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I haven't built "where it should 
be done" into the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Let's go to the hot springs on 
that day!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...! I'm sorry, did I keep you waiting?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I planned to take repeated 100-second 
baths... but it seems I soaked for too 
long.
choice_data_list: You really had fun, didn't you?
You really had fun, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I had forgotten just how hot Japanese 
hot springs can be...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: May I go outside to cool down for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...It definitely feels like night out now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm fine. In fact, it feels rather 
nice...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
……Hier bin ich Mensch, hier darf ich's 
sein――

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's a famous German poem. I just felt 
like humming it for some reason...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I'm getting sentimental. 
Between the excitement and the hot bath, 
my head feels all light and floaty.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"What's even worse is that... I find 
myself thinking it's okay to have times 
like that."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Could you please turn a blind eye to 
the way I am right now?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Then please, allow me to speak a 
little more."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I will continue striving to 
become my true, perfect self to the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yet its completion is likely something 
that takes an entire lifetime...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot acknowledge myself while I am 
still so immature and in progress."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why... I need you by my 
side, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I cannot accept myself. But if you can 
validate who I am...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I can... move forward.
choice_data_list: I will always believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That day we first met... I pushed myself 
too hard and failed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yet even that took on meaning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Because pushing myself to strive for 
perfection was what allowed me to meet 
you...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This time we have right now is... the 
heaven that we have built up together, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Eishin Flash...
